run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute minimum cost to connect weighted nodes from an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in main
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which finds min value and returns min times sum minus min
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that calculates minimum connection cost for weighted nodes
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use built-in min and sum instead of manual iteration
